answer: In the nebula, agents vote on peers' identities by solving crystal puzzles. Correct votes earn 5 copper; submitting an identity costs 5 copper. If caught in a honeypot, an identity burns 10 copper. Attackers pay 10 copper per fake identity submitted, linearly scaling with the number of identities. Honest agents pay once for initial verification. Incorrect votes to honeypot peers reveal colluders, increasing the penalty for running multiple fake identities.
